mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte depletion (particularly potassium and magnesium), which impairs mexiletine elimination and increases risk of cardiac arrhythmias and toxicity.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (K+, Mg2+), and mexiletine levels closely; maintain adequate hydration and consider alternative antifungal if possible; dose adjustment of mexiletine may be necessary.
